acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Fungalfolk family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Fungal Shaman, T4, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Spore-Script Champion (Champion) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two earth construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: Parasol cap, glowing suspended spore script, and the first smaller mushrooms growing along both arms.
Signature mechanic: Living Script: three smaller mushrooms pulse in sequence, drawing a visible spore glyph whose open stroke remains the safe route.
battlefieldDuty: Control three zones by writing temporary script in suspended spores and routing it through smaller arm mushrooms.
constructionDimensions: Tier-safe anatomy: T1 has no glow, no constant spore cloud, no smaller mushrooms, no throne, and no ground network; T2 alone adds faint gill glow; T3 adds its constant spore cloud; T4 adds smaller mushrooms; T5 adds throne and ground network.
Mineralized stalk rings, sediment cap layers, crystal mycelial braces, localized dust, and pale load fractures create rooted mass without confusing damp substrate with affinity.
counterplay: Follow the open glyph stroke and sever the first small mushroom stem before the script repeats. Affinity signal: Tier-safe anchors: T1 has no glow, no constant spore cloud, no smaller mushrooms, no throne, and no ground network, so a mineral ring fractures at its stalk; T2 faint gill glow pauses above a brace; T3 constant spore cloud reveals the planted fault; T4 smaller mushrooms mark the loaded stem; T5 throne and ground network expose the cracked node.
forbiddenTreatments: Mineral bulk that hides stalk and gills
identityInvariants: Cap-headed, stalk-bodied silhouette with gills, bulbous limbs, and a wider top than base remains recognizable.
Pale fungal flesh and one strong cap tone contrast with bounded cyan or green gill bioluminescence from T2 onward.
Fungal flesh, spongy cap, mycelium, damp moss, and spore dust remain organic and spatially coherent.
Cap breadth, gill light, spore density, secondary growth, and ground mycelium escalate at explicit source tiers.
telegraph: One arm mushroom opens its gills and the parasol cap tilts toward the first suspended symbol.
